run_detection_service: run the ZMQ detection server on port 21001 to receive images and return object detection predictions
load_model_owlvit: load the OWLv2 object detection model and processor from HuggingFace onto the specified device
detect_objects_in_image: detect objects in an image using text queries and return bounding boxes with confidence scores
segment_with_sam: segment detected bounding boxes in an image using the SAM model and return masks
review_detect_function: review the detect function to understand how it processes text queries and returns sorted detection results
